top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
top_sast_rules.description: Finds uses of cryptography algorithms that are unapproved or otherwise weak.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Identify usage of weak or deprecated cryptographic algorithms and practices
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use modern cryptographic algorithms and proper key management. Avoid deprecated algorithms and implement proper random number generation.

top_sast_rules.description: When checking a Hash over a message, a constant-time algorithm should be used. Otherwise, an attacker may be able to forge a valid Hash for an arbitrary message by running a timing attack if they can send to the validation procedure. A successful attack can result in authentication bypass.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use constant-time algorithms for sensitive comparisons. Implement timing attack mitigations for authentication and cryptographic operations.

top_sast_rules.description: Making a client-to-server request with user-controlled data in the URL allows a request forgery attack against the client.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement URL validation with allowlists of permitted destinations. Use network segmentation and validate all outbound requests.

top_sast_rules.description: Checking for the "javascript:" URL scheme without also checking for "vbscript:" and "data:" suggests a logic error or even a security vulnerability.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to CWE-184. Review OWASP guidelines and CWE documentation for detailed mitigation strategies.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
top_sast_rules.description: Replacing a substring with itself has no effect and may indicate a mistake.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Detect output operations that lack proper encoding for the target context
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use context-appropriate encoding for all output. Implement proper encoding libraries for HTML, JavaScript, URL, and CSS contexts.
